detail.longDescription: So, I'm looking for a freelance mission or somthing like it, in the devops field. I work on the whole chain from the local environment on developers computer to production (usually cloud and Kubernetes but I'm not tied to those), including pipelines. I can create infrastructure but maintain existing ones too, I follow best practices and I write documentation. I live in France and work remotely (occasional trips are possible, ideally to Lyon, Clermont-Ferrand or even Paris but I can travel farther if it's not too frequent) and I don't want to use AI to work. If in-house services, I'm available 4 days per week (I can work with less of course).
